meta.title: Modules
meta.description: AutoMod AI, AltGuard, server logs, tickets, welcome messages, social notifications and more. Explore every Moddy module and set it up from the web dashboard.

hero.title: Everything your server needs. Nothing it doesn’t.
hero.description: Turn on only the modules you want and set them up from the web dashboard or with /config in Discord. Moddy never needs the Administrator permission.

moderation.name: Moderation
moderation.title: Safety, handled.
moderation.description: AI that reads context, a case for every sanction and a log of everything that happens.

welcome.name: Welcome & roles
welcome.title: A warm welcome, every time.
welcome.description: Greet newcomers in public or in private, hand out the right roles and review applications without leaving Discord.

community.name: Community
community.title: Keep the conversation going.
community.description: Support tickets, highlights, creator updates and voice messages everyone can read.

customization.name: Customization & tools
customization.title: Make it yours.
customization.description: Give Moddy your server’s look and keep everyday tools one command away.

automod.name: AutoMod AI
automod.description: Detect harmful messages in real time, with context, and warn, mute or ban automatically.

cases.name: Moderation Cases
cases.description: Track every sanction as a case with a reference code, a full timeline and built-in appeals.

altguard.name: AltGuard
altguard.description: Gate new members behind a consent-based check that flags suspected alt accounts dodging your bans.

logs.name: Server Logs
logs.description: Record 163 events across 18 categories in the channels you choose, with who did what.

adaptiveSlowmode.name: Adaptive Slowmode
adaptiveSlowmode.description: Raise and lower slowmode automatically as a channel heats up and calms down.

welcome.name: Welcome Messages
welcome.description: Greet new members with custom messages and styled cards in up to 5 channels.

welcomeDm.name: Welcome DM
welcomeDm.description: Send each new member a private welcome message, with placeholders and an optional embed.

autoRole.name: Auto Role
autoRole.description: Give roles automatically on join, with separate lists for members and bots.

autoRestoreRoles.name: Auto-Restore Roles
autoRestoreRoles.description: Remember a member’s roles when they leave and give them back if they return.

memberApplications.name: Member Applications
memberApplications.description: Review Discord’s Apply to Join applications from a channel, with Approve and Reject buttons.

tickets.name: Tickets
tickets.description: Let members open private support tickets from a panel, with categories and per-role permissions.

socialNotifications.name: Social Notifications
socialNotifications.description: Announce YouTube uploads, Twitch streams, Bluesky posts and RSS updates in your server.

starboard.name: Starboard
starboard.description: Re-post popular messages to a highlight channel once they reach a set number of reactions.

voiceTranscription.name: Voice Transcription
voiceTranscription.description: Add a Transcribe button under voice messages, or transcribe them automatically.

bumpReminder.name: Bump Reminder
bumpReminder.description: Thank whoever bumps your server, then call the channel back as soon as the next bump is ready.

interserver.name: Inter-Server
interserver.description: Bridge a channel with channels in other servers for real-time, cross-community chat.

botCustomization.name: Bot Customization
botCustomization.description: Style Moddy’s name for free, or give it its own nickname, avatar, banner and bio with Moddy Max.

utilities.name: Utilities
utilities.description: Translate text, set reminders, extract text from images, generate timestamps or roll dice.

cta.title: Up and running in minutes.
cta.description: Add Moddy to your server, then turn on your first module from the dashboard.
